groupUrls.title: LinkedIn group URLs
groupUrls.description: List of LinkedIn group URLs to crawl.

maxItems.title: Max posts per group
maxItems.description: Maximum number of post items to collect from each group.

targetDate.title: Target date
targetDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. The Actor still returns all collected posts; backend applies final filtering.

scrollTimes.title: Scroll times
scrollTimes.description: Maximum number of scroll actions performed on each group page.

delayMinMs.title: Minimum delay between scrolls
delayMinMs.description: Minimum randomized wait time in milliseconds after each scroll.

delayMaxMs.title: Maximum delay between scrolls
delayMaxMs.description: Maximum randomized wait time in milliseconds after each scroll.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of group pages crawled in parallel. Keep this low to reduce blocking.

storageStateJson.title: Playwright storage state JSON
storageStateJson.description: Optional Playwright storage state as a JSON string with cookies/localStorage.
